title: EffectDescriptor
description: The {kind, target, reversible} shape naming a protected effect. Stdin to `effect declare` / `effect observe`; embedded as `effect` in declare/observe records and (kind+target only) in decision payloads. `kind` enum mirrors EFFECT_KINDS in bin/lib/effects.js; a given producer may only cause the subset in its own `admitted_scope`. `reversible` defaults to true when omitted (normEffect). Semantics live in ../records.md.

target.description: what the effect acts on (branch, PR base, "ISSUE:from->to", ...)
